instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: Which one is NOT a step of requirements engineering?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس خطوة من خطوات هندسة المتطلبات؟
questions.explanation: The four steps are elicitation, analysis, documentation and review; design comes later.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطوات الأربع هي الاستخلاص والتحليل والتوثيق والمراجعة، أما التصميم فيأتي لاحقاً.

questions.question: Requirements elicitation means...
questions.explanation: Elicitation covers gathering, capturing and understanding what the stakeholders really need.
questions.explanation_ar: الاستخلاص يشمل الجمع والتقاط وفهم ما يحتاجه أصحاب المصلحة فعلاً.

questions.question: SRS stands for...
options: None of the above answers here
options_ar: لا شيء مما سبق أعلاه هنا
options_en: None of the above answers here
questions.explanation: SRS is the Software Requirements Specification, the frozen statement of what must be built.
questions.explanation_ar: SRS هي مواصفة متطلبات البرمجيات، وهي البيان المثبَّت لما يجب بناؤه.

questions.question: The SRS document is for...
options: the what of the whole system
options_en: the what of the whole system
questions.explanation: The SRS fixes what the system must do, leaving how it is designed to the next phase.
questions.explanation_ar: المواصفة تثبّت ما يجب أن يفعله النظام، وتترك كيف يُصمَّم للمرحلة التالية.

questions.question: The requirements review process is carried out to...
options: to improve the quality of the SRS
to spend much more time gathering
none of the above at all here
options_en: to improve the quality of the SRS
to spend much more time gathering
none of the above at all here
questions.explanation: The review validates the SRS, so its purpose is to raise the document's quality.
questions.explanation_ar: المراجعة تتحقق من المواصفة، فهدفها رفع جودة الوثيقة.

questions.question: Which statement is NOT correct during requirements engineering?
questions.question_ar: أي عبارة غير صحيحة في هندسة المتطلبات؟
options: Requirements are always subject to change
options_en: Requirements are always subject to change
questions.explanation: Requirements are rarely known precisely at the start, which is why elicitation exists.
questions.explanation_ar: المتطلبات نادراً ما تكون معروفة بدقة في البداية، ولهذا يوجد الاستخلاص.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a type of requirements?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس نوعاً من المتطلبات؟
questions.explanation: The classification is known, unknown and undreamt; complexity is not a category of it.
questions.explanation_ar: التصنيف هو معروفة وغير معروفة وغير متوقعة، والتعقيد ليس فئة منها.
